materialBoundaries.counterexample: A file supplies or swaps a selector to grant an arbitrary admin principal, role, tenant, site, object, or environment.
materialBoundaries.invariant: Credential-file bytes may supply only token facts; each exact tokenId-selector pair must map to one source-owned principal, role, and scope before authentication or RBAC.
materialBoundaries.legitimateControl: The v2 DTO has only tokenId, tokenHash, binding, disabled, notBefore, and expiresAt; an immutable value-returning five-row table fixes principal/role/scope and rejects every wrong tokenId-selector pair.

materialBoundaries.counterexample: disabled:null becomes false or expiresAt:null becomes unlimited, or an atomic path replacement supplies bytes after validation.
materialBoundaries.invariant: Missing optional activity fields are legal, but explicit null, wrong types, duplicate/unknown keys, malformed time, unstable paths, symlinks, hardlinks, and unsupported files must fail closed.
materialBoundaries.legitimateControl: RawMessage shape checks require literal booleans and JSON time strings when present; the typed decoder validates time values, and the existing strict path/owner/mode/stability verification surrounds parsing.

materialBoundaries.counterexample: A second read seeds a different principal set, a failed refresh revives an old SnapshotRef, or both bundle and runtime believe they own the manager.
materialBoundaries.invariant: The API Store and manager begin from the same stable read, refresh only through v2 without fallback, and exactly one runtime owner closes the manager on every pre/post-transfer failure.
materialBoundaries.legitimateControl: The constructor injects the initial snapshot into the first refresh and asserts pointer/digest identity; later reads are v2-only, refresh invalidates before failure, Consume is one-use, and RunWith transfers close ownership only after a nonnil runtime exists.

materialBoundaries.counterexample: A broad build compiles the exact hook or leaves both exact and default hooks absent/present.
materialBoundaries.invariant: Only the exact Linux service/native/continuous-fault selection may activate v2 credentials; ordinary, old-fault, and completion selections retain legacy v1 behavior.
materialBoundaries.legitimateControl: The exact expression and default expression are logical complements; new authn and MODEL files carry the exact tag, and shared RunWith receives a no-op default claim outside that selection.
materialBoundaries.runtimeRoot: serverruntime continuous recovery hook build selection

materialBoundaries.counterexample: The v2 schema is treated as an allowlist exception or a raw private token/credential scalar reaches a public artifact.
materialBoundaries.invariant: Structural credential separation must not weaken whole-file, scalar, eight-variant, first-phase, or final-phase secret rejection.
materialBoundaries.legitimateControl: encoded_secret_variants, build_forbidden, and fence_outputs are byte-identical to base by independent AST-byte hashing; worker changes only add source/format paths, and the E2E private file no longer carries public role/scope metadata.
materialBoundaries.runtimeRoot: continuous_recovery_api_worker privacy inventory and output export
